reason: I only have Saturdays with my kid and the zoo is free, so paying $16 for a play cafe isn't something I'd do most weekends. I'd probably use the free first visit on a rainy day and then go back to the zoo.
objection: $16 a weekend visit when the zoo costs nothing, and it feels a bit Instagram for Salisbury. I'd need a real reason beyond a nicer room to keep paying.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price closer to $10 per kid, or a bad-weather or winter stretch where the zoo isn't an option and I need somewhere indoors.
